flux.description: Chart pins (OCIRepository tags, HelmRelease chart versions) and the images in HelmRelease values.

kubernetes.description: Container images in core's and the add-ons' own manifests.

packageRules.description: The flux CLI (mise.toml) moves with the Flux version core's FluxInstance runs, so an operator's CLI matches the cluster.

k3s host binary is pinned in cluster-vars.yaml and changes only by PR, opened after approval in the dependency dashboard. A bump has to re-check core/platform/traefik and update the bundled chart and k3s versions in core/platform/traefik/CONTRACT.md.

Mover image stays on the VolSync chart minor. The backups contract depends on that minor's behaviour. Raise the cap in the same PR that bumps the chart to the next minor. One PR still updates every mover pin.
The VolumeSnapshot CRD is vendored and nothing updates it. Put the re-check where the reviewer of a VolSync chart bump sees it.
prBodyNotes: Re-check `core/platform/backups/controller/volumesnapshot-crd.yaml` against the external-snapshotter client this VolSync release imports.

packageRules.description: The restic and rest-server images and the matching CLI pins in mise.toml move in one PR, because the rest-server isolation test requires them equal. Renovate updates mise.lock in the same PR.
One PR updates the Kyverno chart, every Kyverno image digest pin and the kyverno CLI in mise.toml; Renovate updates mise.lock in the same PR.
One PR updates the cert-manager chart and every cert-manager image digest pin.
The flux-operator chart and its image digest pin (the chart's appVersion) move in one PR.
Helm host CLI version and sha256 are bumped together by PR, opened after approval in the dependency dashboard.

kubectl and the admission test's kube-apiserver (mise.toml) move together and stay on the k3s minor. Raise this cap in the same PR that moves k3s_version to the next minor. A test fails if they drift apart.
Renovate reads aqua:kubernetes/kubernetes/kube-apiserver as the repository kubernetes/kubernetes/kube-apiserver, which does not exist; its releases are kubernetes/kubernetes's.
The admission test's loopback etcd is the one kubeadm pairs with kubectl's minor (1.36: etcd 3.6). Raise this cap in the PR that moves kubectl to a minor kubeadm pairs with etcd 3.7.
Python packages in pyproject.toml update as one PR; Renovate updates uv.lock with them. Exact == pins stay exact.
ansible 15.x requires ansible-core 2.22.x. Raise this cap in the same PR as an ansible major bump. Patch updates inside 2.22 still flow.
The devcontainer's base image is pinned by tag; Renovate adds and moves its digest.
The kubernetes manager also reads each object's apiVersion. An API move is a code change, not a pin bump.

Patches, digests, pins and minors merge on their own once every check on the PR is green. Renovate merges them itself (GitHub's auto-merge stays off), so the quickstart checks count too. It touches these PRs only overnight Pacific, so main doesn't move under a daytime batch: it opens, rebases (main requires branches up to date) and merges them then. It merges one per run. Majors stay manual; k3s and the Helm CLI need a sha256 by hand.
Below 1.0 a minor can break, so those stay manual like a major.

customManagers.description: Core's k3s release in infra/ansible/group_vars/all.yml, which every env runs unless it overrides it. k3s_sha256 is bumped by hand in the same PR.

A `# renovate:` comment over a version line: the Flux distribution in core's FluxInstance, which every env runs at its core tag, and the Helm host CLI for the flux-operator role's bootstrap. A Flux bump merges only after the Flux Operator version that supports it is live, because the operator ships the manifests for each Flux version.
The mise release the devcontainers install: core's own (.devcontainer/devcontainer.json) and the instance one jarvis init writes (jarvis/kit/devcontainer/setup.sh).
The core release docs/quickstart.md starts from (JARVIS_VERSION), read against the repository its install line names. A release tag opens the PR that moves it; nothing is bumped by hand at a release.
The example apps jarvis init --with-examples pins (jarvis/kit/examples-apps.yaml): <app>: v<version>, the tag <app>/v<version> in jarvis-apps, the apps repository beside core.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Weekly PR refreshing the packages uv.lock and mise.lock hold beyond the direct pins (Python's transitive dependencies).
